Title: Rishabh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Karan - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Karan stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh walks across the courtyard.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Flower petals rain down on Rishabh.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Rishabh (gently): "Let's see."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Rishabh (gently): "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Rishabh stands on the road. Kavita and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Rishabh sits in the back seat.]

Rishabh: "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Kavita: "That's great!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Rishabh in the back.]

Rishabh: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The garden - Day

[Rishabh stands in the garden. Kavita and Karan stand near him.]

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh waters the plants.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look at this."

[Rishabh chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Kavita: "And then?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh opens his umbrella.]

Rishabh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh puts on his raincoat.]

Kavita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
